description: Isomorphic (Node + browser safe) canonical token-usage normalization: folds every agent-CLI backend's heterogeneous usage metadata into one NormalizedTokenUsage shape. Shared by the server persistence path and the chat UI so the SAME normalization runs everywhere.
name: @openthrottle/agentic-token-usage

options.command: tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json && (node --experimental-strip-types ../../scripts/verify-dist-complete.ts . || (echo 'verify-dist-complete: incomplete dist — forcing a clean rebuild' && rm -rf dist && tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json && node --experimental-strip-types ../../scripts/verify-dist-complete.ts .))

verify-dist-complete.description: Fail if dist/ is missing any compiled source module — guards the poisoned-Nx-cache truncated-dist class (tsc --build no-op against stale output). See plan 935ea415 and the poisoned-gcs-nx-remote-cache runbook.
